[![SteveGilmore](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/5/5c/SteveGilmore.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/200?cb=20211003085249)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/5/5c/SteveGilmore.png/revision/latest?cb=20211003085249)
**Steven Gilmore** is an American automotive designer who was one of the six designers who participated in the [Hot Wheels Designers Challenge](/wiki/Designers_Challenge); he represented the [Ford Motor Company](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ford_Motor_Company), for he was Design Manager of Ford, by designing the [Ford Gangster Grin](/wiki/Gangster_Grin) for said series. Gilmore has been with Ford since 2000, and is one of two Designers Challenge designers with ties to Hot Wheels before going onto professional design; he interned at Mattel for four months in 1998 during college. He is currently Design Chief of Vehicle Personalization at Ford.
